fact: The Portfolio Committee on Social Development says SASSA runs the SRD grant application and payment system, which a review rated at medium threat level.

DSD News reports that the Department of Social Development has signed MoUs with government departments to develop and implement the National Integrated Social Protection Information System (NISPIS), an electronic data management system integrating data from several sectors to improve targeting of social protection.

SASSA's acting Chief Information Officer told Parliament's social development committee that the Social Relief of Distress (SRD) system, established in 2020, processes about 17.8 million applications with an average of 8 million approvals a month, validated through real-time interfaces with Home Affairs, SARS, GEPF and DPSA.
SASSA told the committee it uses banking checks to prevent fraudulent grant payments and that only fully FICA-compliant bank accounts are now used for grant payments.
